tasks.title: Notify validates reference-only channels and preserves remote definitions in ledger format 5
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, config/schema/remote validation/channel-set/ledger files and related Checks; Decisions 2, 11-13 and format-5 portion of 14; Contract fields (notify env); Counterexamples (references and whole channel); Security impact (local reference boundary). Pin @lorenzh/pulse-contract to the full merged main SHA containing 2.4.0, regenerate bun.lock, and keep all other dependency pins and the runtime package set unchanged. Implement token/token-file, poll settings and secret-directory config, database-only startup with optional/empty file only when token exists, and file webhook urlEnv/urlFile while preserving literal file url and existing local secret rules. Expose per-channel resolution with the stricter contract shapes plus notify-local prefix/basename/realpath rules for database channels; no database file transport and no secret values in durable remote definitions. Keep api calls/poll scheduling for T2. Implement the pure whole-channel effective-set/per-id definition-and-resolved-secret-digest diff used by T2, with last-good-per-channel fallback. Migrate the ledger from 4 to 5, preserving every entry, alert state and recipient mark; create remote_channels and resend_commands tables now, complete their transactional read/write APIs and persist reference-only last-good remote definitions. No separate migrations in later tasks. Prepare durable command admission/result operations that T3 consumes without splitting Ledger.resend and command bookkeeping across non-atomic writes. Wire startup mode enough for zero-channel and cached-remote startup to work while the existing service remains green. Tests in the plan's new src paths coexist with the current test/ suites; update the existing format and CLI regression suites rather than assuming src tests already exist. Document ledger format 5, no downgrade and offline CLI behavior in AGENTS.md/operation docs.

tasks.title: Notify reloads channels without losing pending jobs or sending old incidents
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, remote polling/channel reconcile/report/metrics/client/wiring files, live-channel Behavior and Checks; Decisions 5-6 and 11-13; Counterexamples (whole-channel shadowing and references); Security impact (transport/redaction). Build on T1's ledger and resolution boundary: poll all database definitions every 15 s with conditional etags and re-read the local file by bytes hash at each poll; validate wire/body with manual redirects, timeout 5000 ms and 1 MiB limit. Send Bearer on /service/* only, keep public feeds unauthenticated, support old-api 404 fallback/log once and api-down cold startup from the persisted snapshot. Atomically reconcile the effective set by id and report file-channel views, rejections and newest-200 failed entries plus total after every apply attempt and at least each 60 s. Keep worker lifecycle and pending-job handoff in this one task: stop new jobs on replaced workers, let an in-flight attempt end/time out, transfer waiting/pending keys without double ownership; removals keep pending ledger state, re-additions resume it once, new/widened routes seed quietly, email progress survives type changes. A slow channel must not block other workers or the settings poll. Register metric series as channels are installed. Provide delivery final-result hooks for T3, including dropped outcomes and channel/key identity. Apply every routing field live and finish its matching/nonmatching tests. Document routes, polling, origins, last-good fallback and secret-rotation behavior.

tasks.title: A claimed resend sends a failed event once and reports durable outcomes
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, resend-command/live-enqueue/result-callback files, remaining Checks and Completion evidence; Decision 14; R1 resend states; R2 notify claim/result routes; Counterexamples (resend); Security impact; Performance impact (notify); Acceptance evidence. Consume the T1 durable command APIs and T2 mutable workers to poll claims every 5 s, admit only failed entries with payloads into the installed worker immediately and post admission then final results. Durable command-id bookkeeping makes a replay report the stored result without re-running Ledger.resend, even when the first resend failed again. Retain atomic admission plus ledger pending-state change and recover/repost after process restart; keep the event key, webhook idempotency-key and email Message-ID. Handle not-failed/no-payload/channel-unavailable and admitted -> delivered/failed/dropped, including stale reminders and partial SMTP recipient progress. Shut down all settings/command/report loops before closing the locked ledger. Recheck CLI offline operation and lock exit 2 on format 5. Finish all section tests, docs, full checks, security checklist, pinned workflow comparison, baseline red/green, performance and manual live-channel/resend evidence in the PR.
